title: Native phone capabilities demo (Option A)
description:
Prove Fortoid can use phone hardware from the WebView bridge, with a built-in demo screen for a KERI Foundation demo.

## Success Criteria
- Debug APK installable on a real Android phone, downloadable from GitHub
- Demo screen buttons exercise: device info, biometric unlock, hardware keystore keygen+sign (biometric-gated), QR scan
- Every capability goes through the existing hardened bridge (trusted origin, main frame only) with a request/response protocol
- JVM unit tests for protocol parsing and dispatch

title: README: demo app docs
description:
Document demo launcher, bridge protocol, how to install APK.

## Acceptance Criteria
- README section explains install + capabilities

title: Biometric capability
description:
biometric.authenticate via androidx.biometric BiometricPrompt.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Demo button prompts fingerprint/face; success/cancel/error reported to page

title: Hardware keystore capability
description:
keystore.generate / keystore.publicKey / keystore.sign using AndroidKeyStore EC P-256 (StrongBox when available), signing gated by biometric CryptoObject.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Key generated in hardware, public key returned, signature verifiable with returned public key
- Reports whether key is StrongBox/TEE backed
close_reason: HardwareKeystore capabilities + demo card with WebCrypto verification

title: QR scan capability
description:
qr.scan using camera (zxing-android-embedded), CAMERA permission requested at runtime.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Demo button opens scanner, decoded text returned; cancel reported

title: Demo screen + Fort Native Demo launcher
description:
Bundled assets/demo page served at /demo/ via asset loader; activity-alias launcher opens it in the same hardened WebView.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Second launcher icon opens demo page
- Demo page can call device.info and show result
close_reason: Demo page + /demo/ handler + Fort Demo launcher alias; APK packages verified

title: CI: build debug APK and publish for phone install
description:
Workflow builds real FortWeb payload + debug APK on push to main, publishes to rolling demo prerelease.

## Acceptance Criteria
- APK downloadable from fork releases page on phone

title: Bridge request/response protocol
description:
Pure-Kotlin NativeBridgeProtocol: parse {type:native_request,id,capability,params} and build native_response envelopes.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Malformed/oversized/unknown requests rejected with structured errors
- JVM tests cover parse + response building

title: Dispatch native requests in MainActivity + device.info
description:
Route native_request to a capability registry, reply via JavaScriptReplyProxy. First capability: device.info.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Unknown capability returns error response
- device.info returns model, sdk, manufacturer
close_reason: Dispatcher wired into MainActivity bridge; device.info capability
